description: The shapes read once a CSV has been imported: the size/row/column LIMITS the client pre-flights against, one imported CSV's CATALOG (nested inside a sources listing or a SELECT), the GET /api/evidence-csv sources listing, a paginated SELECT of one committee/cycle's rows, and the bounded error-payload shape (never a leaked Python exception string). Orientation only - the examples are the contract.
